_about: The type scale settings: each one's label, unit, limits, step and help.

base_size.label: Base text size
base_size.help: The size of body text. Everything sized in rem scales with it. At least 14px, so text stays readable.

scale.label: Heading scale
scale.help: How much bigger each heading level is than the next (h6 is the base size). 1.25 is a common choice.

line_height.label: Line height
line_height.help: Space between lines of body text, e.g. 1.5.
